title: QUIC RFC 9000 Initial Packet Format Focused Proof Verification
verification_method: Focused S17P2P2 requirement-home tests, Release build, regenerated QUIC coverage triage, and SpecTrace JSON validation.
scope: This verification covers focused Initial packet-format parser, Initial packet-protection builder/open, and repository-owned Initial payload handling proof for the listed S17P2P2 requirements.
expected_result: S17P2P2 requirement-home tests prove the Initial long-header type, header-form/fixed/reserved/packet-number-length bits, version field, connection-ID length boundaries, Token Length and Length varint validation, packet-number length validation, zero server token length, client Retry token preservation, Initial protection DCID dependency, Initial CRYPTO/ACK payload shape, disallowed frame handling, and first-client-Initial CRYPTO framing.
procedure: Run the focused S17P2P2 requirement-home filter.
preconditions: Existing long-header parser behavior remains the canonical wire-format parser for version 1 Initial packets.
Existing Initial packet-protection behavior remains the canonical DCID-derived protection floor.
Existing Initial payload handling remains discard/error scoped for disallowed frames.

supplemental_sections.heading: Boundary
supplemental_sections.content: This verification does not claim broader handshake success, interop readiness, or frame-policy closure outside the listed S17P2P2 requirements.

status_summary: Passed locally on 2026-05-04. The focused S17P2P2 filter passed 79/79, regenerated QUIC coverage triage marked all 26 S17P2P2 requirements trace_clean, and final Release build plus SpecTrace JSON validation are recorded by this verification run.
